notes:
Lead source: inbound sign-up from pricing page. Use-case: sales reps get concise call summaries and coaching highlights; also want automatic CRM notes and keyword-based highlight extraction.

PII / retention concerns (customer quotes):
- "We can't keep full transcripts for longer than 30 days; names/phones must be redacted for non-admin users."
- Wants an option to disable transcript storage and opt into ephemeral processing.

Technical/ops details:
- Target concurrency: ~50 reps, but initial POC will be 5 active reps (10-15 concurrent short requests).
- Throughput expectation: ~1.5k calls/month initially, scaling to 20k in 12 months if POC successful.
- Latency target: UI shows summaries in <1s preferred; 500-800ms acceptable for short summaries.
- Model preference: smaller cost-optimized LLM for extractive summaries; will test higher-quality variants for coaching feature.

Security asks (action items):
- Provide SOC2 scope statement and data flow diagram (customer asked specifically about transcript storage and who has access).
- Offer retention controls + API to delete transcripts programmatically (legal requirement).
- Clarify whether Redwood hosted logs include raw transcripts by default and how to opt out.

Commercial notes:
- ARR sensitivity: wants conservative estimate and a clear path to move to Dedicated only if unit economics justify it.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching to reduce per-call cost.

Quotes / reps commentary:
- CEO: "We love the speed of the demo — main blocker is PII retention and legal signoff."
- Head of Product: "Can we demo auto-redaction and retention TTL in the sandbox?"

Next steps (repeat):
- Send sandbox API key + security FAQ + sample retention config JSON.
